name: TapRefer

sources.title: Homepage — affiliate programs directory for creators, 10,400+ programs, ~4k users
Submit page — affiliate-program submission guide; sign-in required (Google OAuth); review within 48h

requirements: This lists AFFILIATE/REFERRAL PROGRAMS, not plain products — you need a working affiliate signup page, a clear commission structure, and referral tracking
Sign-in required to submit ('Sign in to Submit' → Google OAuth popup)
Accepted types: SaaS, AI tools, ecommerce, courses, digital products, agencies with referral programs, subscription products, etc.
Incomplete info, broken links, unclear terms, or unsuitable offers are rejected; review within ~48 hours
Required listing info: brand name, square logo, product type, short description, category, commission rate, cookie duration, affiliate program URL, product website, contact email
preparation: A live public affiliate/referral signup page
Commission rate, cookie duration, and tracking details
Accurate contact email — they may follow up for missing info
workflow: Fill program details: name, website, affiliate signup URL, commission, cookie duration, category, contact
Submit — reviewed within ~48 hours; incomplete submissions take longer
On approval the program appears in the directory for creators to discover and apply
watchFor: It's an affiliate-program directory — submitting a product without an affiliate program will be rejected
The whole site pushes TapRefer Pro ($49 lifetime) for SEARCHING programs — irrelevant to listing your own program
Aggressive countdown/flash-sale marketing ('20 left') — cosmetic urgency
Updates to commission/cookie/URL require contacting them — no self-serve edit mentioned
countsAsLive: The affiliate program appears as a listing in taprefer.com's programs directory with an 'Apply now' link to your signup page
unknowns: Whether paid featured placement affects editorial approval
Any fee for listing itself — none was shown on the submit page, but confirm in the form
